name: Sandy Elliott
story: Sandy Elliott (Alexander Elliott in research citation metadata) contributed to NIWA's catchment water-quality modelling work. Elliott was among the named authors of the 2008 iEMSs paper describing the CLUES spatial decision-support system and its integration of farm-scale nutrient models with regional and national river-network analysis.
The historical evidence establishes authorship and modelling contributions during the 2000s. More detailed career chronology has not been independently established here.
